name: Fairlife Core Power Elite High Protein Shake (Strawberry)
whyItWorks: Made with ultra-filtered fairlife milk treated with lactase enzyme (0g lactose) delivering 42g of high-biological-value whey and casein protein with 0g fiber. Exceptionally creamy and easily digested by lactose-sensitive guts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Chill ice-cold in the fridge and drink half or a whole bottle after workouts or as a morning protein boost.
